notes.title: Improved compatibility with the Oculus Rift
notes.content:
- Towards a Perilous Journey is now fully compatible with Rift Core 2.0 and Oculus Dash.
- The ranking are now shared with Oculus and Viveport players.

notes.content:
Improved weapons balancing and levels balancing.
Added an option for automatic shooting.
Improved compatibility with the Vive Pro.

notes.title: Ranking improvement
notes.content:
Towards a Perilous Journey now manages the rankings with PlayFab. This implies that rankings are now compatible across multiple platforms. You are now competing with players from other platforms than Steam .

Other changes:
- Improvement in the way enemies appear
- Fixed a bug in the final score which was not always consistent
